$description: Happy HR design tokens, shared by the web app (web/src/styles/tokens.css) and the iOS app (ios/HappyHR/Design/Theme.swift). Golden hour dark is the default; light follows the device or the person's choice.

onHoney.$note: Text on any honey fill, both themes

accent.$note: Deeper honey so it reads on cream

honeyFill.$note: Live pins, selected chips, primary button

display.use: Wordmark, sheet titles, venue names, ring numbers, prices

motion.pulse: Live pins pulse every 2.2 s; off with Reduce Motion

glass.$note: Web imitates glass with backdrop blur; iOS 26 uses the real Liquid Glass (.glassEffect). Glass is for the floating layer only, never glass on glass.
floating: the bottom sheet (iOS draws this itself)
venue hero emoji and lead price
honeyTint: lead price on the venue hero
notGlass: cards and rows inside the sheet: quiet fills (cardFill)

components.statusRing: 52 pt (64 pt on the venue page); honey arc = share of happy hour left; ember when 30 min or less

pins.live: 14 pt honey dot, cream rim, glow, pulsing; glass honey label with the cheapest special
pins.soon: 12 pt ink dot with honey ring; label shows the start time
pins.noHappyHour: 7–8 pt faint dot; honey-tinted when a daily special runs today
pins.dailyView: 12 pt ink dot with honey ring; honey label with today's special

components.todayPill: Dashed honey outline, honey text, 'Today · <special>': a quiet note, never a timer
